homeFaqs.question: Where is NW Fuel located?
homeFaqs.answer: Our head office is at #101-18940 94th Ave, Surrey, BC — on the north side of Highway 1, beside Finning. We also have a sister location, Island Diesel, in Nanaimo at #8, 1975 Boxwood Road.

homeFaqs.question: What are your business hours?
homeFaqs.answer: We are open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM. We are closed on all statutory holidays.

homeFaqs.question: What brands of diesel parts do you carry?
homeFaqs.answer: We carry Bosch, Pure Power, Alliant Power, Stanadyne, Yanmar, Delphi, Dipaco, Denso, FASS, and many more. We never offer something we wouldn't install on our own vehicles.

homeFaqs.question: What warranty do you offer?
homeFaqs.answer: All products and service work carry a 12-month unlimited km warranty from the invoice date.

homeFaqs.question: Why don't you provide quotes over the phone?
homeFaqs.answer: Our technicians need to physically inspect and test your components to provide an accurate quote. We always get approval before proceeding with any work beyond initial testing.

homeFaqs.question: Can you test my injectors?
homeFaqs.answer: We can test 99% of common rail, HEUI, and EUI injectors. For unusual applications, call us first. Mechanical injectors start at $16, common rail at $65.

contactFaqs.question: Do you offer emergency service?
contactFaqs.answer: For urgent diesel injection issues during business hours, call us directly at (604) 882-3835. Our team will prioritize your request based on severity and current workload.

contactFaqs.question: Can I drop off injectors without an appointment?
contactFaqs.answer: Yes, walk-ins are welcome during business hours. For faster service, we recommend calling ahead so we can prepare for your specific injector type.
